end.parentNote: Ananya practised estimating by using a known group as a guide and explaining three groups of ten as 30. They also noticed that spreading the same eight bangles does not change the count. At first, the reason for choosing a closer estimate was unclear, but they later identified 43 as closer to 43 than 40. At home, show a small collection, make one known group, and ask Ananya to estimate the rest using that group.
